questions.q: If n(A) = 10, n(B) = 8 and n(A ∩ B) = 3, what is n(A ∪ B)?
How many elements does the power set of a set with 3 elements have?
questions.explanation: The power set has 2ⁿ elements, so 2³ = 8.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {3, 4}, what is A ∩ B?
How many subsets does the set {a, b} have?
According to De Morgan's law, (A ∪ B)′ = ____.
questions.explanation: The complement of a union is the intersection of complements.

questions.q: If A = {1, 2, 3, 4} and B = {2, 4}, what is A − B?
questions.explanation: A − B contains elements in A but not in B.
